messages:
evan: Heads up: booked a shared AirBnB for an 8-person customer workshop. I used my personal card to reserve and paid the cleaning fee/gratuity upfront. Can I expense my share and charge the company for the portion that covered attendees? Also, how do we handle receipts for group bookings?

nina (People Ops): For group bookings where the company is the host for customer workshops, expenses can be split: company pays attendee-related costs (room rental, catering, workshop materials). Personal incidental costs or optional upgrades are personal. For a personal card transaction, provide itemized invoice showing line items and indicate which lines should be billed to company. If itemization isn't available, provide a short allocation note and attendee list.

liam (Finance): Finance needs: booking invoice showing total, a breakout of which nights/rooms were for employees vs guests if possible, card statement line, names of attendees and whether company or external, and manager approval. We also need to know if any GST/VAT is reclaimable.

 evan: Cleaning fee is non-refundable and was $150, split across 8 people. Is that reimbursable per person? Also I added a service fee tip of $40.

nina (People Ops): Cleaning fees that are part of venue rental for a business event are reimbursable. Tips for services can be reimbursed if reasonable and part of the event. Keep receipts and annotate allocation.

liam (Finance): For per-person split, either the company can reimburse the company-share in full and employees can handle personal shares, or we can reimburse you for the company portion directly. Submit the allocation in the expense notes: e.g., total cleaning $150, company owes $100 (for client attendees), personal share $50. Attach attendee list and manager sign-off.

 evan: One more: the platform invoice shows only a total $1,200, not split by line. Host support says they can provide invoice with line items but it takes 5 business days. Will that block reimbursement?

liam (Finance): If vendor can provide itemization, great — that'll speed things up. If not, Finance can accept the total with an allocation memo and manager sign-off, but it'll be queued for manual review and may take longer.

 expense-bot: Reminder: attach attendee list, itemized invoice or allocation memo, card statement line, and manager approval.

 evan: Thanks, uploading now. I'll ping once support sends the itemized invoice.

 nina (People Ops): TL;DR: Company covers venue/catering for client-facing event; provide itemized invoice or allocation memo, attendee list, manager approval, card statement line. Cleaning/tips reimbursable if reasonable. :white_check_mark:
